desc: Ideation and approach selection: layered DP over subarray count with monotone convex hull trick.
Implement `minimumCost` in the starter code with prefix sums, rolling DP, monotone CHT using integer arithmetic, valid index handling, and final minimum over all subarray counts.
Test the implementation on the provided examples, edge cases such as `n = 1`, all-single-element partitions, and small random inputs against an O(n^3) brute force; fix any failures.
